snippet.title: Kevin Orders Pizza. The TV Answers. #MovieScenes
snippet.description:
In the Home Alone (1990) pizza delivery scene, Kevin McCallister uses a gangster movie on TV to answer the Little Nero’s delivery guy without opening the door.

Music: “Sneaky Adventure” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Edited and mixed for this Short. Licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
